BebboSSH 1.45 by Stefan "Bebbo" Franke: SSH2 client, server, scp and key
generator for the Amiga (68000 and up), as published on Aminet:

  https://aminet.net/comm/net/bebbossh.lha   ($VER: 1.45 (30.03.2026))
    bebbossh, bebboscp, bebbosshkeygen, bebbosshd, libcryptossh.library
    (68000), libcryptossh.library020 (68020-68040, 68080),
    libcryptossh.library060 (68060): the archive's binaries, unmodified
    bebbossh.readme, COPYING, template/sshd_config: from the archive
    (template/passwd, the author's sample login, is left out)

  bebbossh-1.45-src.tar.bz2: the complete corresponding source, the
  author's repository https://franke.ms/git/bebbo/bebbossh at commit
  057c7f3 ("cleanup and release 1.45").

Licence: GNU General Public License version 3 or later (COPYING, beside
this file); some files are public domain, as their headers say.
UP-Term installs the client tools in SYS:UP-Term/bin and the library in
LIBS: (README, NETWORK); thoughts/shared/research/2026-10-03_ssh-for-up-term.md
in UP-Term's source has what was measured.
